sky.qualification: Nereid's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Neptune-system ephemeris. Representative model pole from Kiss et al. (2016), Fig. 8: ecliptic longitude 320°, latitude 32°, converted using J2000 obliquity. It is one possible model orientation, not a unique measured pole. The display meridian is arbitrary, not a current landmark phase.
provenance.qualification: Computed Nereid Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
